vehicle.description: CARLA 0.9.15 vehicle.lincoln.mkz_2020 with its default physics, as Bench2Drive spawns it. Raw readout: docs/reference/mkz2020_physics_control_0.9.15.json; the parameters the urban NMPC plans with, derived in docs/vehicle_parameters.md; actuation tables: mkz2020_actuation.json (scripts/identify_ego.py).

sources.carla: read from the blueprint's physics control

a.description: centre of gravity to front axle
a.note: front axle 1.472 m ahead of the actor origin, centre of mass 0.30 m ahead of it

b.description: centre of gravity to rear axle
b.note: rear axle 1.389 m behind the actor origin, plus the centre of mass's 0.30 m

F_brake_max.description: peak brake force at the wheels
F_brake_max.note: m x 7.7 m/s^2, full brake at 10-20 m/s (scripts/identify_ego.py); the brake torque alone (4 x 800 N m / 0.355 m) would give 5.3 m/s^2

delta_max.description: road-wheel steering angle limit above 120 km/h
delta_max.note: road-wheel angle for steer 1 at 20 m/s (it is 1.1 at 3 m/s): the smaller, so it holds at any speed

delta_rate_max.note: CARLA steers without a rate limit (a 0.15 s lag). At 1.5 rad/s the offline overtakes (sim/urban, a kinematic plant with lags on acceleration and steering) steer back faster than the lagged plant follows, overshoot the lane and swerve; 1.0 is borderline
